_note: State monuments at Gettysburg National Military Park. Each coordinate below was individually sourced and cross-checked against Wikipedia/NPS-derived listings (see 'source' on each entry), not estimated or generated. This is a starting set of the major, most historically significant monuments (one primary memorial per state), not the park's full ~1,328 monuments and markers -- Ohio and Michigan, for example, funded many individual regimental monuments instead of one state memorial, so they have no single entry here. Expand this file with the same format to add more.
